name: Jimmy Bower
description: '''Jimmy Bower''' (born September 18, 1968) is an American musician, best known as the guitarist for [[sludge metal]] band [[Eyehategod]] and drummer for [[southern metal]] supergroup [[Down (band)|Down]]. He previously also played drums with [[Crowbar (American band)|Crowbar]] (with Down bandmates [[Kirk Windstein]] and Todd Strange) and [[Corrosion of Conformity]] (with Down bandmate [[Pepper Keenan]]), and rhythm guitar in [[Superjoint]] (with Down bandmate [[Phil Anselmo]]).
